steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Amiya, Doctor. You're here.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Haha, as you can see, the morale here... is rather low right now.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: It's a mess, but please pay it no mind. Ever since Allerdale... left, our logistics have been in shambles.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: But given the problems we face, this is the best solution we have.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: We lost many men in our last battle. We once thought that these sacrifices would not be in vain, and that as long as we stopped the Sarkaz's projects, everything would still be salvageable.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Regrettably, they acted much faster than we anticipated.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The Sarkaz... Not only do they have the Shard, they also built that 'airship.'

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The report has been distributed to everyone. The airship attacked the Duke of Windermere's army out in the open. The illusion of peace has shattered.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: As for the Shard... if the Sarkaz willingly started this war, then their control of the Shard... must have proceeded much further along than we expected.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I'm too afraid to make this gamble.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale once told me the legend of this sword.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: She said that the Sighs of Kings, capable of rending Catastrophes asunder, is Victoria's strongest shield, with which the country can defend against the storms pulled toward it.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Then she must also have told you that the 'Stone of the Sword' beneath the palace exists precisely because there are few who can activate this power.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege, do you really feel nothing from the sword?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Maybe... I don't know, like a sense of being summoned? Or perhaps there's a low heat? Maybe you can suddenly use some really wicked Originium Arts?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: You just... might actually be able to...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No, nothing.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The sword is cold and hard. It's a little lighter to swing than a hammer, and not very easy to control your strength with.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Is there nothing else? If any part of you feels a little bit off—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We should have this polished before it sees the battlefield again. It's a little rusted.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: It seems we can't count on the sword doing us much of a good turn and helping us fend off the threat from the Shard for the time being.

options: But it also won't become a bargaining chip in the dukes' internal strife.
The Sarkaz might just think twice before they activate the Shard.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Right, Doctor of Rhodes Island. It is better for this sword to be under our control than any other faction. At the very least, being able to prevent it from becoming an accomplice to this war is important enough.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Important enough...? This is important enough...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: (Hushed) Allerdale, if only I...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please don't get discouraged, Siege. Maybe you just haven't gotten the hang of it, or it's not time yet.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm just about done analyzing that supply line, Doctor.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's practically guaranteed that the starting point is rural Brentwood, but it's got a lot of endpoints.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Aside from the munitions factory in Highbury, it's very likely they have a route that extends right underneath the Shard.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Argh, we found out way too late. If only we'd found out a month—no, ten days sooner, things probably wouldn't have turned out the way they have.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: That said, the intel about this supply route is still meaningful, Doctor.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: If this route is capable of the transport of heavy supplies and leads straight to the bottom of the Shard—

options: We can transport more than supplies there.
This is an opportunity for a counter-offensive.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: With war having broken out, there may not be a lot of guards around Theresis. Each lord of the Royal Court has to command their subordinates to fend off the dukes.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: The liches joining the fray would be a problem... but from what I know about them, they wouldn't truly pick a side. Besides, I'm sure Dame Kal'tsit talked to their Messenger before.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: I just hope that they opted to follow her advice.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Now, we'd best—

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina, you ought to at least bring up what happened in Norport!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: It's our turf that those Sarkaz arseholes gutted out! Baird is still there!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Bloody bastards! Instead of a counter-offensive on their supply line, we should be helping them!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Calm down. We must think about the whole situation...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You little twat, you think being a knight gives you the right to teach me to look at the big picture? I don't give a shite about wiping out some old Sarkaz monsters. My friends are in danger. My home is in danger!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: And you want me to bloody stand aside and do nothing?!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: No, I know you're restless, but we must consider all possibilities.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I do not recommend splitting up. Until we are certain the ones who attempted to take the Realmblade have given up, you'd best...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Best cower underground like cowards? Give me a break! We can take care of those sneaky bastards! What we have to do now is—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Enough, Indra.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: When will the operation targeting Theresis commence?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Not very soon. We need time to observe the supply line's specific situation.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: The Shard's internal structure needs to be investigated too. Theresis... He's powerful. Letting our guards down would only spell our doom.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: How long will it take more specifically?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Less than half a month. I hope to put a stop to all this before he truly activates the Shard.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That's good enough.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I am requesting a temporary leave before this operation. Please rest assured that I will be back before the operation is to commence.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: So you insist on going to Norport.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I've lost enough friends already, Clovisia.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I can't just do nothing over and over again.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I am making this request out of my personal feelings, yes. I won't try to hide this.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But at the same time, I think this is an opportunity. Before our normal operation officially begins, we can first remove certain hidden threats.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: For example... those who hurt Allerdale and those who want the Sighs of Kings.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That's without a doubt a duke. No matter what position he is planning to take, I think... I should have a... conversation with him.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Ascalon said this already, but time is not on our side.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I will handle this properly.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Doctor, what do you think?

options: There are still things worthy of our attention on that plate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right... The Sarkaz airship is very likely docked in Norport.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And this also implies...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She... Theresa might be there.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In this war, we will have to face her sooner or later.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: There is another thing. Logos mentioned to me—

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Emergency... ission... Emergency...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: The Sarkaz ambushed... the Camden Borough safe house... We.... Their forces...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Urghh—

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Camden? What's going on?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Alert... The safe house at Auchterigg...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: ...being ambushed...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Feist! The safe house in Highbury is under attack!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What's the situation over there?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: We're mounting a counter attack and are evacuating underground. The situation's dire. It's likely that the Sarkaz have...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: This is not a simple annihilation. They are planning to...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: ...must...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny? Granny, do you hear me?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Drat, the transmission's cut off!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What's going on? We have three safe houses under attack by the Sarkaz!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Their communications have been cut off. We must back them up immediate—

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: No, it's not just the three safe houses.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Our communications have been cut off.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Get down, Doctor!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Clovisia, what's going on?!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: How can this be? Here...? This place is top-secret within the Self-Salvation Corps!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Logos mentioned to me that it's possible the Sarkaz have infiltrated our intelligence network.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Based on the situation we now find ourselves in, I can only assume that the failure of our confidentiality far exceeds what we anticipated.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: It's very likely that all Self-Salvation Corps bases are under attack.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: We must evacuate!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Where can we go, though...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Everyone, the Sarkaz assault is fierce. They've had their eyes on this place for a long time, and the routes on the surface have already fallen.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: They—

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: The mid-level buffer zone has been breached, too.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Doctor, the enemy is using a new Sarkaz witchcraft device. With their numbers and strength... Our Defense Forces and Self-Salvation Corps friends won't be able to withstand this assault.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Truth be told, we have no chance of winning. Robben, who's in charge of organizing defense, won't last very long.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: How much time can they buy us?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Fifteen minutes... No, half an hour.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That's all the time we have.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Evacuate? Where are we supposed to run? There isn't anywhere safe for the Self-Salvation Corps to go in Londinium!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The equipment factory's third warehouse? The carpark at the Four Seasons Department Store? Maybe Viscount Byrne's mansion...?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: No, they're all too risky.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: There has to be somewhere else...

options: If it's dangerous everywhere in Londinium, we can evacuate the city for the time being.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Evacuate Londinium?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Right! The Sarkaz supply line!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We can use the supply line in Highbury and get the hell out of Londinium!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We've got too many wounded men and non-combatants. Taking an underground route will help us avoid most of the fighting!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But all our work in Londinium...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The onslaught we are facing tells us that they simply thought they had no need to wipe us out before.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Now that war has broken out, the Military Commission has started to truly see the Self-Salvation Corps as a threat.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We have no time to hesitate.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I need to head out immediately to back Robben up. We will try to draw the Sarkaz main force's attention the best we can to cover your evacuation.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Amiya, Doctor. The Self-Salvation Corps will need your assistance in this evacuation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We will never abandon our allies.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: I am on it.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I'm here.

options: Help Horn and her team buy us time.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Rest assured, Doctor.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I will guarantee your safety.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Before we could finalize plans to relocate and secure our communications... The Royal Court picked the perfect time for this annihilation operation.

options: It seems they know us better than we ever imagined.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Theresis has also gotten sharper... not like when he was simply pretending.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: If it's certain that this place will fall, I guess... it won't matter if we go all out.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Logos, we will be back!

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You can rebuild this place.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Next, we need to find the entrance to the Highbury supply route.

options: Feist, this is where you come in.
Rockrock, you know the underground passages better than anyone.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Understood. Everyone, come with me.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Rest assured, I will evacuate safely with the wounded.

options: Closure, take all the wounded and non-combatants and go with them.
I'm counting on you and Shining to take care of Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wha? Huh?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hey, Dr. {@nickname}, what kind of sick joke is this?! If I'm supposed to be a non-combatant, then so are you!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You bet your ass I can beat the crap out of you! It's you who should be evacuating with the rest of them!

spans.text: You bet your ass I can beat the crap out of you! It's
who should be evacuating with the rest of them!

options: Amiya and Ascalon will make sure I will be safe.
We will hold the Sarkaz pursuers. This is the safest way.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... I won't let you get hurt.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Tsk, crafty dipshit.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So, we've got three teams.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Horn, Misery, and Logos will lead the primary operation to resist the Sarkaz assault. Doctor, you go with Amiya and Siege's gang to hold the other Sarkaz pursuers.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Shining and I will follow the rest of the Self-Salvation Corps and evacuate this place without making any noise.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Where are we gonna meet up in the end?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The small town outside Londinium... Brentwood.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Alright, objective confirmed.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're now in war.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It won't spare any one of us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But we also... mustn't lose hope.
